answer.book: A Latin printed dialogue (Tiguri, Froschouer, 1561) by Peter Martyr Vermigli, in which Pantachus and Orothetes debate whether Christ's human nature is everywhere, preceded by a dedication to John Jewel and followed by a dedication to Elector Frederick III and a Responsio; the dialogue text has no numbered divisions.
